text: On Coinone 1m, only large Upbit impulses (upbit_lead_impulse thr_bp 40, k 1/3, non-quiet KST hours) produce a Coinone catch-up larger than the 4 bp conservative round trip within 5-30 min.
rationale: int-000001: the 1m lead is real (z 4-11) but per-event excess 1.3-2.9 bp < cost; per-event excess grew with thr_bp (10->20) in camp-000001, so the next block-grid value (40) is the minimal test. Same mechanism M1, same family; trials accumulate.
success_criteria: BH q=0.10 over all family screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at best primary horizon (5/15/30).

text: Coinone 5m bollinger_z_revert(96, 2.5) with/without trend_regime_1h(24), held 120-240 min with wide ATR exits (SL 6, TP 6 ATR) that approximate the event study's time exit, passes G0-G5 on Dev.
rationale: int-000003: camp-000005 TP 3 / SL 5 ATR may truncate the 120-240 min reversion drift measured by screen camp-000004; this tests a time-dominated exit on the strongest screened configs (z 2.5). New campaign in the same family (2 signal configs x 2 exit variants = 4 specs).
success_criteria: At least one spec passes G0-G6 and the Dev robustness suite; refuted if Dev Sharpe < 1 and G4 rolling fraction < 0.6.

text: Coinone 5m donchian_breakout(288) carries materially more net information when 5m realised vol is in the top 20% of its trailing 7-day range (vol_regime min_pct 0.8).
rationale: int-000004: breakout info is thin (net 2-3.5 bp) and grew with the 0.67 vol filter (1.95 -> 3.52 bp at 30 min); if the M3 cascade story is right it should concentrate further in the top-vol regime. K-P0-4 (lockbox+Val exposed) is motivation only; 0.8 is a block-grid value.
success_criteria: BH q=0.10 over family screen configs, n_events >= 300, net mean > 0 and at 60-120 min >= 2x the 0.67-filter net mean.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, upside breakouts of multi-day highs (donchian_breakout 24/48/144 h), ATR-channel breakouts and persistent positive EMA slope (ema_slope span 48) are followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost; optionally only in high short-term vol (vol_regime 0.67) or above the 1-week EMA (trend_regime_1h 168).
rationale: Mechanism M3 (mechanisms.md) extended to multi-hour horizons: volatility clustering plus slow information diffusion and trend-following flows (CTA/retail momentum chasing, stop and short-liquidation cascades on derivatives venues spilling into KRW spot) make multi-day highs and persistent EMA slopes continue over 4-24 h (time-series momentum). Counterparty: stop orders and liquidated shorts at breakout levels, counter-trend limit sellers who fade new highs, and late retail chasers we sell to on exit. Why it persists: forced liquidations are price-insensitive; trend capacity at hours horizon is large and crowded-out by nobody on a minor KRW venue. Kills it: long-only spot in bear regimes (2022), false breakouts in low vol, regime beta masquerading as signal (pitfall P-S6) - the matched (KST hour x vol) null removes unconditional drift only within the eligible pool. 5m version (camp-000003/6) was information-thin at 15-30 min (fact-000003, fact-000006, int-000004); re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' is met (15m/1h/4h engine added 2026-11-09). Filters: vol_regime(24,0.67) tests the M3 high-vol story; trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is the regime-filtered-trend variant (hypothesis c). Evidence exposure: fact-000003/6 Dev only (lockbox none, Val none); K-P0-4 (lockbox+Val exposed) motivates the vol filter only, its value is the block default/grid value, not derived from it. Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 1h (and 4h screen), coinone_conservative primary cost, upbit_conservative grade cost; long only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior family screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (bar-minute preset). Reported, not gating: upbit_conservative net (grade A/B) and per-year excess (pre-registered side calculation).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 15m decisions, closes far below the rolling mean (bollinger_z_revert window 24/96, z 2.5) are followed by 1-4 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost, with and without a 1h trend filter (trend_regime_1h 24) or a 1-week bull-regime filter (trend_regime_1h 168), and the excess is not concentrated in one Dev year.
rationale: Mechanism M4 (mechanisms.md): forced liquidations / panic selling push KRW spot below fair value and partially rebound once the price-insensitive flow ends. Counterparty: force-liquidated levered longs and panic-selling retail; liquidity provision during cascades carries inventory risk most participants avoid. Kills it: information-driven drops, second-wave cascades, bear regimes. This re-examines the family at 15m/1h decisions (re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' in fact-000005/fact-000008) and explicitly tests int-000005 (unverified): that the 5m trend-filtered reversion is bull-regime dip buying concentrated in 2021 rather than liquidity-provision income. trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is a slow bull-regime filter: the matched null is drawn from the same filtered pool, so a filter-only (regime beta) effect does not count as signal. Pre-registered diagnostic (side calculation, no ledger): for every passing config, per-calendar-year excess at the best primary horizon; int-000005 is supported at this timeframe if the excess is positive in fewer than 3 of the 5 Dev years or one year carries > 50% of the summed excess. Evidence exposure: fact-000004/5/8 and the camp-000008 ad-hoc robustness are Dev only (lockbox none, Val none). Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 15m and 1h, coinone_conservative primary, upbit_conservative grade; long only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior family screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (bar-minute preset). Reported, not gating: upbit_conservative net (grade A/B) and per-year excess (pre-registered side calculation).

text: Coinone BTC-KRW 1h: atr_channel_breakout(span 24, mult 3) with ATR exits (SL 2/3 ATR x TP 1.5/3 ATR, max hold 480 min = information horizon) earns positive coinone_conservative net returns that pass G0-G5 on Dev and the robustness suite.
rationale: Mechanism M3 at multi-hour horizons (time-series momentum: slow information diffusion, trend-following flows, short-liquidation/stop cascades). Counterparty: counter-trend limit sellers and stops at breakout levels, late chasers we sell to at exit. Kills it: bear regimes for a long-only spot book (2022 excess ~0 or negative in the per-year side calculation for several configs), false breakouts, regime beta (robustness alpha check). Screen camp-000009 (Dev only, lockbox none, Val none) passed this entry; exits are ATR multiples centred on the screen's MFE/MAE suggestion and max hold at the information horizon. Pre-stated expectation: Dev Sharpe >= 1.5 with leave-year-out and alpha checks passing; per-year side calculation showed 2022/2025 weakness, so REGIME_DEPENDENT is the predicted failure mode. Screen config: n=1165, info horizon 480 (peaked), net +29.0 bp at 480 (Upbit grade cost +14.9 bp); suggestion TP 1.41 ATR, SL 2.03 ATR.
success_criteria: At least one spec passes G0-G6 and the Dev robustness suite (latency, outliers, leave-year-out, cost x1.5, regime, alpha, cross-venue). Refuted for this timeframe if the best Dev Sharpe_w < 1 or leave-year-out/regime/alpha fail.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, atr_channel_breakout(24,3) carries more information per event when 24h realised vol is in the upper half / tercile of its trailing 7-day range (vol_regime 0.5 / 0.67), and that information is present in down- and sideways-30d regimes, not only up-trends.
rationale: int-000006: the 1h ATR-channel momentum passed G0-G5 on Dev but its PnL is concentrated in up-trend 30d regimes (Dev robustness regime FAIL). Mechanism M3: breakouts in high vol carry stop/liquidation-cascade flow (counterparty: stops and liquidated shorts, late chasers). Dev robustness showed high-vol tercile Sharpe 2.2 vs low 1.0 (Dev only, lockbox none, Val none). The G6 outcome of camp-000013 is NOT used to choose anything here; filter values are block-grid values. 2 configs; repeat-free (the unfiltered config is already in camp-000009).
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon; and (side calculation, pre-registered) excess at 480 min > 0 in down and sideways 30d regimes separately.

text: Coinone BTC-KRW 1h: atr_channel_breakout(span 24, mult 3) taken only when 24h realised vol is in the upper half / tercile of its trailing range (vol_regime(24, 0.5 / 0.67)), with ATR exits (SL 2/3 ATR x TP 1.5/3 ATR, max hold 480 min = information horizon), earns positive coinone_conservative net returns that pass G0-G5 on Dev and the robustness suite (incl. regime share <= 70%).
rationale: Mechanism M3 (multi-hour time-series momentum; in high vol, breakouts trigger stop/short-liquidation cascades and trend-following flow). Counterparty: stops and counter-trend sellers at breakout levels, late chasers we sell to at exit; persists because liquidation flow is forced and Coinone is too thin for large arbitrageurs. Kills it: bear regimes for a long-only spot book, Upbit-level costs (grade B), false breakouts in high vol. Evidence (all Dev; lockbox none, Val none): screen camp-000015 (fact-000015) passed both configs: vol 0.5 n=850 p=3e-4 net +33.3 bp @480 (Upbit +19.3), vol 0.67 n=678 p=6e-4 net +39.0 bp (Upbit +25.0), info horizon 480 peaked; exit suggestions TP 1.38-1.40 ATR, SL 1.80-1.86 ATR. Motivation from camp-000013 Dev robustness only (up-trend 30d days 74% of PnL; high-vol tercile stronger); the G6 outcome of camp-000013 is NOT used. Exits are held identical to camp-000013 (SL 2/3 x TP 1.5/3 ATR, hold 480) so that the only change vs camp-000013 is the vol filter (isolates the filter; the set brackets the screen suggestions). Logged side calculation camp-000016 (9 configs, Dev): excess at 480 by trailing-30d trend tercile: unfiltered down 33.9 bp z 2.83 / sideways 27.3 z 2.41 / up 27.5 z 2.44; vol0.5 25.3 z 1.71 / 41.2 z 3.04 / 31.8 z 2.24; vol0.67 13.3 z 0.79 / 40.1 z 2.63 / 44.4 z 2.66. The grid was fixed before this side calculation and not changed by it. Pre-stated expectation / predicted failure modes: robustness regime share (up-trend) and G4 recent-12-month Sharpe (2025 weak in every momentum config); the vol filter thins down-regime events, so REGIME_DEPENDENT remains the most likely failure; G5 margin is thin (required Sharpe 1.29 vs camp-000013 Sharpe 1.46).
success_criteria: At least one spec passes G0-G6 and the Dev robustness suite (latency, outliers, leave-year-out, cost x1.5, regime share <= 70%, alpha, cross-venue). Refuted for this filter if the best Dev Sharpe_w is not above camp-000013 representative (1.02) or the regime check still fails.
